Corollary
[Interior Harnack inequality] 1. ch9:9.25\group chapter-9Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0262 If $u\in W^{2,n}(\Omega )$ satisfies $Lu=0$ and $u\ge 0$, then for every $B_{2R}(y)\subset \Omega $, \begin{equation} \tag {9.63} \sup _{B_R(y)}u\le C\inf _{B_R(y)}u, \end{equation} where $C=C(n,\gamma ,\nu R^2)$.
Proof

\sketch Combine the weak Harnack inequality with the local maximum principle, using the weak-Harnack exponent in (9.48).

□
